stateController.primary: watchHostOrganizerScope + organizerTabControllerProvider + HostOrganizerEditController + HostTeamManagementController + hostFormPaymentControllerProvider + hostEventDefaultsControllerProvider + HostEventCommands + HostProfileController + hostInsightsControllerProvider
stateController.notes: The /host/organizer route resolves through hostOrganizerScreenForUri: the Organiser tab (OrganizerScreen) by default, the page editor for tab=page or tab=edit and for editField links, the event policy for the activity, admission, ages and cancellation fields, Settings, Insights, or the public page for tab=preview. Each screen reads the signed-in host and the selected organizer through watchHostOrganizerScope. Page and media edits run through HostOrganizerEditController, the host team through HostTeamManagementController, the Razorpay connection through HostFormPaymentController, event defaults through HostEventCommands with a journal for unconfirmed saves, and the host profile through HostProfileController.

designRefs.notes: Organiser tab tests cover the page, the last thirty days, the organizer switcher and the rows into the page editor, Settings, team, payments, memberships, audience, live guide and tracking; page_edit, settings_screen, team_settings_memberships, payments_body and event_policy tests cover each screen.
Host team management tests cover add/remove/transfer affordances and mutation feedback for the embedded Host Clubs team section.

Host Organizer reference is repo-pinned and registered. The standalone-host workspace adds private-to-public publication coaching and cross-event CRM readiness. Its deterministic 2026-08-10 full-shell comparison is bounded at mismatch 20.09%, meanDelta 25.94, maxDelta 240, masked 260416 under HOST-STANDALONE-ORGANIZER-WORKSPACE-001 while the canonical threshold remains unchanged; analytics, payout, and editor variants remain blocked until exported references exist.

The Host Insights source is pinned and a routed 390x812 production capture exists. Repo-owned PNG export and focused comparison remain open because the headless-Chrome exporter was denied by the 2026-07-10 Codex execution-credit limit; HOST-V2-INSIGHTS-REFERENCE-001 stays active.
